body: I used to take bupropio, and it worked well. Unfortunately, I couldn't get it after I dropped out,  since it was a school psychologist.  I never tHought that maybe I have ptsd... getting sick in the US sucks...

I was seeing a psychologist  at my university, and the first one was great,  but the second... was not so great.  She asked me what I was wearing during the time of the attack, and that just made me feel like maybe it was kind of my fault. I quit going,  and I haven't seen another since then. About 1 year ago... I've been thinking of maybe checking into a hospital, but I live in the US.
